issues.description: Extraction hard-requires story files and manifest that are not present, so a fresh tiny/full run fails immediately.
The advertised end-to-end tiny test fails at extraction because the required story corpus is missing.
Documentation claims the tiny full pipeline runs on CPU, but the checked-out repo cannot reproduce extraction.
Only Python packages are included, so config/data artifacts are not packaged for installed CLI usage outside the repo.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 is accepted but still removes one component instead of removing none.
Validation constructs a backend from CLI flags instead of the vector manifest, allowing mismatched model/vector provenance or shape failures.
Preference validation also ignores vector manifest backend metadata and can score artifacts with the wrong backend.
Custom emotion configs with no matching built-in scenarios crash or produce invalid means instead of a clear validation error.
HF steering falls back to all prompt tokens when offset mappings are unavailable, so it may not steer only activity tokens.
HF preference scoring uses a single-activity good-minus-bad prompt, not an actual pairwise preference comparison as documented.
Only the first token of encoded ' good' and ' bad' is scored, which is wrong for tokenizers where those strings are multi-token.
Core config values are not validated, allowing empty emotion lists, invalid layer fractions, and nonsensical counts to fail later.
Dependencies use only lower bounds and no lock file, making scientific/demo outputs vulnerable to dependency drift.
The demo script always starts with fresh extraction, so the committed sample outputs do not make the demo runnable when input data is absent.
